behavior: Usually seen in pairs or small family groups, foraging in trees, shrubs, and on the ground for fruit and other plant matter. Climbs and hops through branches, runs readily, and gives loud, raucous choruses most often around dawn and dusk.
field_marks: Large, chickenlike body with a long neck
Small grayish head with a short dark bill and brown eye
Dull olive-brown back and rounded wings
Long, rounded blackish tail with pale tips
Long dull-gray legs; bare red throat patch visible when exposed
habitat: Dense scrub, brushland, riverine woodland, forest edge, and dry or moist forest, often where thick understory occurs near water.
